377:t_10:37.en:
$$シモン$$
「I understood what it said this time, at least.」

378:t_000:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We caught up! It looks like whoever stole the $$Ｖコン$$ still isn't used to the controls!」

378:t_001:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「They've shown up now...? Are they connected to whoever stole the $$Ｖコン$$!?」

378:t_001:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$正太郎$$! Leave those things to us!」

378:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You, $$タケル$$ and $n must pursue the thief who stole the $$Ｖコン$$!」

378:t_002:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It looks like $$鉄人$$ isn't moving.」

378:t_002:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Then let's focus on the small fry around it!」

378:t_002:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Wait! I've detected a high-energy reading from $$鉄人$$!」

378:t_003:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's solar energy! But the power is off the charts!」

378:t_003:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This power...! It's the same as when it defeated $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

378:t_003:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is someone trying to make $$鉄人$$'s solar energy go out of control!?」

378:t_003:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Can you hear me, $$０８$$? You have to shut down $$鉄人$$'s solar energy converter!」

378:t_003:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's no good...! We can't stop $$鉄人$$, and at this rate, even $$０８$$ won't last inside it!」

378:t_003:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If $$鉄人$$ explodes like this, this entire area will be reduced to ash!」

378:t_003:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's like the sun has come down to Earth...!」

378:t_003:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This is bad! There's a city not far from here!」

378:t_003:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then if we leave $$鉄人$$ like this, it'll explode and engulf that city...!?」

378:t_003:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We have to... stop it before that...」

378:t_003:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$鉄人$$ is $$正太郎$$'s precious partner! We can't let it hurt anyone!」

378:t_003:14.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's right! We're going to stop $$鉄人$$!」

378:t_003:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! I can't lose when it comes to being hot-blooded!」

378:t_003:17.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To do that, we must break through the enemy units surrounding it...!」

378:t_003:18.en:
$$勝平$$
「That robot army! They followed us here!?」

378:t_003:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「They just won't learn! We already gave them a real beating!」

378:t_003:20.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「My calculations are complete. For now, $$鉄人$$ appears unlikely to explode within four minutes.」

378:t_003:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「Understood. Then we'll finish off the robot army in four minutes!」

378:t_003:22.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Just watch, $$タケル$$! We'll smash them and put your fears to rest!」

378:t_003:23.en:
$$葵$$
(Whoever is behind that robot army... Is that the cold, dark darkness $$タケル$$ spoke of...?)

378:t_004:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We've cleared out the small fry around us!」

378:t_005:1.en:
$$木下$$
「W-we can't get near $$鉄人$$ like this!」

378:t_005:2.en:
$$柿小路$$
「We have to do it! This is no time to whine!」

378:t_005:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We'll do our best too! So... hurry, $$正太郎$$!」

378:t_006:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Now one of those loathsome powers of light will disappear!」

378:t_006:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...All units, retrieve $$正太郎$$ and the others and retreat.」

378:t_006:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「If $$鉄人$$ explodes, the nearby city won't be safe either!」

378:t_006:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...There is nothing we can do.」

378:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That space robot! Is that $$グーラ$$!?」

378:t_008:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Demon Beast Prince! What are you planning to do!?」

378:t_008:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You should understand, if you too wield the power of darkness.」

378:t_008:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I'll create a black hole to absorb $$鉄人$$'s solar energy!」

378:t_008:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Fool! As if your paltry power could do such a thing!」

378:t_008:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Either the solar energy will burn you alive, or you'll lose control of the black hole and be swallowed up yourself!」

378:t_008:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$, son of $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! I'll show you I can do it!」

378:t_010:0.en:
$n
「The solar energy has stopped pouring out...!」

378:t_010:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Did $$グーラ$$'s power do that...?」

378:t_010:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Nice work, $$グーラ$$! You risked your life for one hell of a victory!」

378:t_010:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I learned to fight this way from you.」

378:t_011:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Come on, $$オックス$$! We're going to team up with $$鉄人$$!」

378:t_013:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$... No, $$ズール$$! However many robots you send, don't think you can defeat us!」

378:t_013:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Robot army...? Don't compare my power to those pitiful puppets, $$マーズ$$!」
